messages:
incident-bot: P1 pager fired — decode/stream GPU OOM on node gpu-rt-7 (prod, us-west-2). Trigger: cudaMalloc failed while streaming decode. Affected routes: /v1/stream, /v1/chat-stream (partial). Paging ben (oncall).

alice (runtime): I'm looking at runtime traces now. KV cache growth spike for a small set of sessions — per-request token append rate jumped way above normal. Seeing many sessions with sustained token rates ~15k-25k tokens/min.

ben (oncall): I'm on the node. Cordoning gpx node to stop new pods: 
```
kubectl cordon gke-prod-gpu-rt-7
kubectl get pods -o wide --field-selector spec.nodeName=gke-prod-gpu-rt-7
```

carol (sre): grabbing logs from the failing container. Getting repeated: `cudaErrorMemoryAllocation` and `out of memory` in decode loop. Attaching small snippet: 
```
[2026-03-15T18:42:01Z] ERROR decode: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
[2026-03-15T18:42:01Z] WARN decode: request 0x7f8a token-growth=1.2M kv_bytes=14GB
[2026-03-15T18:42:01Z] INFO pod: restart requested
```

dan (support): We have a support ticket from Acme (#9876) complaining of truncated responses and 502s at 18:40 UTC. They reported retries and inconsistent completions. Might be the same.

alice (runtime): preliminary root cause: a client is sending extremely large max_tokens via X-Max-Tokens header (observed values >500k). SDK v1.2.3 changed default in one client causing unintentionally huge generation windows. Runtime was honoring request-level max_tokens and kv cache grew until cudaMalloc failed.

ben (oncall): Immediate mitigation: enforce server-side hard cap and enable per-session token rate throttle. Deploying quick rule: `max_tokens_server_cap=4096`, `tokens_per_second_limit=2000` for streaming endpoints. Applying config now.

ops-bot: Auto-fallback triggered — rerouting 18% of streaming requests to quantized fallback model `redwood-3b-q4` on dedicated pool to relieve GPU memory pressure. Latency +120ms on fallback routes.

carol (sre): Draining node now and restarting container runtime. Drain commands: 
```
kubectl drain gke-prod-gpu-rt-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
# after drain -> kubelet restart and container restart
ssh ops@gke-prod-gpu-rt-7 'sudo systemctl restart kubelet'
```

alice (runtime): Added runtime guard to reject X-Max-Tokens > 100k with 400 and a descriptive error. Also added a temporary per-connection KV-cache ceiling to prevent single session from monopolizing >8GB. Patch pushed to rolling config.

ben (oncall): After drain+restart, node memory stabilized. However we still saw ~2.9% request drops across streaming routes in the last 12m while fallback was ramping. Customer-facing error rate peaked at ~6% for a few enterprise tenants.

dan (support): I patched Acme support ticket with interim remediation: advise retry and add they may experience intermittent partial responses. They asked for ETA on full recovery.

elaine (product): Need to draft a status page update. Impact summary: intermittent 502/partial responses for a subset of streaming requests in us-west-2 between 18:40–19:05 UTC. Engineering has stabilized routing; mitigation in place. ETA for status posting?

ben (oncall): I'll post to status now with that wording and link to support note. Will call out affected routes and that rollback requires SDK patch.

alice (runtime): For long-term: we should validate headers at the edge, add anomaly detection for token-rate spikes, and add automatic server-side caps that cannot be overridden by client. Also need a telemetry alert for unusual KV growth per session.

carol (sre): Captured heap/profile dump and uploader for analysis. Will include timeline with container logs and GPU memory timeline in the postmortem.

ops-bot: Rolling rollback window scheduled at +30m if false positives. Auto-fallback will remain enabled until memory metrics stable for 15m.

ben (oncall): Handoff: frank (next-oncall) — please continue the follow-up, own status updates, and coordinate postmortem. I'm marking incident as "stabilized" but not closed.

frank (next-oncall): Acknowledged — I'll pick this up and work with runtime and SRE to complete RCA and remediation tickets.

alice (runtime): Saved action items: [1] SDK validation and patch to prevent accidental large defaults, [2] server-side hard caps + token-rate limiter, [3] alert for per-session KV growth, [4] postmortem with timeline and customer impact, [5] status page and customer comms.

ben (oncall): Closing pager escalation. If new OOMs occur, escalate to P1 immediately. I'll attach logs to the ticket.

incident-bot: Incident stabilized — paging quiet. Incident ID INC-20260315-001.
